title: Mar Bernal i Fló
text:
PhD Student in Ecology at SLU.  
My research combines bioacoustics, biodiversity monitoring, conservation technology and computational ecology to better understand and monitor forest ecosystems.  


Developing bioacoustic methods for monitoring and quantifying biodiversity in Swedish forests.
